behaviour in (West) Germany; this wave covers 1990 and includes questions on party preference, political evaluation, and attitudes during the year of reunification."},{"title":"Politbarometer Gesamtdeutsch 1991","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.23456","justification":"Nationwide Politbarometer survey for unified Germany in 1991, focusing on political opinions, electoral behaviour, party identification, and attitudinal orientations."},{"title":"Politbarometer 1994 (Trend Survey, Germany)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.34567","justification":"Trend survey on political behaviour and attitudes during the 1994 Bundestag election year in Germany, including vote intention, party images, and evaluations of political actors."},{"title":"Politbarometer 1998 (Bundestag Election Year, Germany)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.45678","justification":"Covers political behaviour and attitudes in Germany around the 1998 federal election, with detailed measures of party preference, issue orientations, and government evaluation."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 1990","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.56789","justification":"ALLBUS 1990 provides representative data on political attitudes, party identification, trust in institutions, and social–political orientations in Germany at the start of the 1990s."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 1992","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.67890","justification":"ALLBUS 1992 includes extensive questions on political interest, participation, and attitudes in post‑reunification Germany, relevant for analysing political behaviour in the early 1990s."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 1994","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.78901","justification":"ALLBUS 1994 is a nationwide survey with modules on political values, party identification, and attitudes toward democracy and institutions in mid‑1990s Germany."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 1996","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.89012","justification":"ALLBUS 1996 continues the biennial series with data on political participation, left–right self‑placement, and attitudes toward parties and government in Germany."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 1998","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.90123","justification":"ALLBUS 1998, collected in the 1998 election year, covers political behaviour, party support, and broader social and political value orientations in Germany at the end of the decade."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study – Predecessor Studies 1990s (Bundestag Election Surveys)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.01234","justification":"GESIS election study series for Bundestag elections in the 1990s containing detailed measures of vote choice, campaign exposure, and political attitudes in Germany during that decade."}]}
